description: Foundational drills for players just starting out. Focus on one skill at a time, slow repetition, and building motor patterns.

drills.name: Wall Pass Repetition
drills.instructions: Stand 5m from a wall. Pass the ball at a marked 50cm square target. Receive the rebound and repeat. 3 sets of 20 passes each foot.
drills.coach_tip: Plant your foot beside the ball, pointing toward the target.
drills.success_criteria: 10 consecutive accurate passes to the target.

drills.name: Straight Cone Dribble
drills.instructions: Set 6 cones in a straight line, 1.5m apart. Dribble through using only your right foot. Then only your left. 5 runs each foot.
drills.coach_tip: Keep the ball within one touch of your foot at all times.
drills.success_criteria: Complete the course without losing the ball.

drills.name: Stationary Shot Technique
drills.instructions: Place ball on the ground. Take a 3-step approach and strike with laces. Focus on planting foot beside the ball. 20 strikes each foot.
drills.coach_tip: Chin down, chest over the ball at the moment of contact.

drills.name: Single-Leg Balance Hold
drills.instructions: Stand on one leg for 30 seconds. Switch. Progress to eyes closed when comfortable. 3 sets each leg.
drills.coach_tip: Stay on the ball of your foot, not your heel.
drills.success_criteria: 30 seconds on each leg without losing balance.

drills.name: Chest Control from Toss
drills.instructions: Partner tosses ball from 3m. Control with chest and let it drop to feet. 3 sets of 15 touches.
drills.coach_tip: Cushion the ball — let it come to you, don't push into it.
drills.success_criteria: Ball stays within 0.5m of your feet after control.
